$comment: Third-party license policy read by scripts/check-licenses.mjs. Verdicts: allow passes; review FAILS unless the exact package@version is listed in the reviewed array with a reason (after reading its license text); deny and unknown fail. packageOverrides entries require an exact version. The license of every vendored entry is classified too. Entries are SPDX ids (case-insensitive) or PREFIX* patterns. Deny wins over allow, allow over review. A compound expression is judged per SPDX semantics (OR: best branch, AND: worst branch).

packageOverrides.reason: package.json declares the ambiguous id "BSD"; the shipped LICENSE file is the two-clause BSD text.
